evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule about creating a game with a name and optional description.
Inviting estimators by URL does not conflict with any other story's permissions or constraints.
Starting a round by entering an item in a multi-line field is not made incompatible by other stories.
Viewing all items for the session does not conflict with other behaviors or constraints in the backlog.
Selecting an item to be estimated or re-estimated is compatible with other stories about item lifecycle.
Adding items to the list is not inconsistent with any other story.
Editing an item aligns with other item-management stories and creates no incompatible constraint.
Deleting an item from the list is consistent with item management and not contradictory to other stories.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This permits revealing estimates before all have submitted, which is incompatible with stories requiring simultaneous reveal after all have given and allowing changes until the last person selects.
Accepting the average of all estimates is not inconsistent with other stories.
Auto-filling the estimate when all estimators show the same card complements other reveal and estimate behaviors without contradiction.
Entering the agreed-upon estimate does not conflict with other stories.
Re-estimating earlier stories is compatible with other lifecycle and estimation stories.
Importing stories from a spreadsheet complements other story-creation mechanisms and is not contradictory.
Copy/pasting stories from a spreadsheet is another input method and does not impose rules incompatible with others.
Browsing previous games is compatible with delete/export features; no story mandates permanence that would conflict with deletion.
Viewing a transcript of a game to see stories and estimates does not directly conflict with other stories; retention semantics are not mandated elsewhere.
Exporting a transcript as HTML for local saving is not incompatible with other stories' behaviors or constraints.
Exporting a transcript as CSV for further processing does not conflict with other requirements.
Deleting a game so its stories and estimates are no longer stored is an action that does not contradict any story that requires permanence by rule.
Creating an account with required fields does not conflict with other stories.
Logging in with account name and password is compatible with other stories and imposes no incompatible rules.
Changing account details is not inconsistent with other stories.
Deleting an account so account info and games are no longer stored does not directly contradict other stories that do not require permanent storage.
Showing dates and times in local timezone is orthogonal to other requirements and not conflicting.
Getting a password reminder by email is not incompatible with other stories.
Selecting card sets (Fibonacci or powers of 2) is a configuration choice and not in conflict with other stories.
Inviting up to 15 estimators sets a limit but does not contradict other stories about invitations or joining.
Joining a game by entering a name is compatible with account and participation stories.
Seeing the item being estimated is consistent with other display and estimation behaviors.
Seeing all items to be estimated this session is compatible with other session views and management features.
Immediately seeing that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator (presence, not content) does not conflict with the requirement to reveal estimate values simultaneously.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This story is internally consistent; the conflict arises from PP-009 which permits early reveal (that story is flagged).

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: This story's rule is consistent; it conflicts with PP-009's early-reveal capability (PP-009 flagged).
Seeing each estimator's prior estimates for the current story is compatible with other stories; it does not directly impose a contradictory rule about reveal timing.
Seeing who gave what estimates during the current round can be satisfied at reveal time and is not intrinsically incompatible with other stories.
Starting a two-minute visible countdown timer is not conflicting with any other rules.
Resetting the timer when all have played an estimate complements timing behavior and is not contradictory.
Scrolling back through prior rounds' stories and estimates is consistent with other retention/export features and imposes no incompatible constraints.
Keeping card order consistent across draws is not in conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: This is consistent on its own; it is incompatible with PP-009's early reveal (PP-009 flagged).
Displaying a thumbnail photo near played cards does not introduce conflicts with other stories.
Compliance with XHTML and CSS standards is orthogonal to other requirements and not conflicting.
Providing a list of definitions for terms does not conflict with any other story.
Creating database indexes to improve query performance is not incompatible with other stories.
Supporting older browsers is not contradictory to other requirements.
Complying with W3C accessibility guidelines where possible is not in conflict with other stories.
Requiring the application to respond quickly is not inconsistent with other backlog items.
Supporting Unicode for any language does not conflict with other requirements.
Sensible and predictable URLs are orthogonal and not conflicting.
Providing nice error pages does not impose incompatible rules with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Storing research results non-identifiably does not explicitly contradict other stories; in-session identity display and research storage can be separated.
Seeing metrics on use of the game is compatible with storage and reporting stories; no incompatible constraint found.
